product.summary: Current Bitget Wallet mobile application for self-custodial multichain Web3 wallet use on iOS and Android.
product.notes: The 2023-08-10 BitKeep-to-Bitget Wallet change is a brand rebrand, not a defensible initial product-launch date. The mobile product preserves the earlier BitKeep Wallet lineage, but its exact initial launch date remains unresolved. Browser extension distribution has a distinct runtime and is intentionally deferred as a separate product boundary.

events.title: BitKeep upgraded its brand to Bitget Wallet
events.description: The BitKeep wallet lineage formally adopted the Bitget Wallet brand after Bitget acquired a controlling stake earlier in 2023.
events.notes: The 2023-08-10 date is rebrand chronology, not an initial product-launch date. The selected mobile product retains BitKeep Wallet as an alias and its initial launch date remains unresolved.

evidence.title: Best Free Crypto Wallet for Web3
evidence.notes: Current first-party wallet page separately offers Google Play, App Store and Android APK mobile distributions and Chrome extension distribution, supporting the mobile-app product boundary and self-custodial current status.

evidence.title: BitKeep Upgrades to Bitget Wallet: A Letter From the Team
evidence.notes: First-party history states BitKeep began in 2018 and formally upgraded its brand to Bitget Wallet on 2023-08-10 after Bitget acquired a controlling stake earlier that year.
